tool_input.command: git stash push app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts -q && bun test tests/PostSearch.test.ts 2>&1 | tail -6; git stash pop -q && git diff --stat
tool_input.description: Verify tests fail against buggy code, then restore

result:
`bun run typecheck` and `bun test` both pass (5 tests, 0 fail), and I confirmed the three new tests fail against the pre-fix controller.

The bug was in `PostController.search` (`app/Http/Controllers/PostController.ts:33`): the published check was `q.orWhere('published', true)` *inside* the keyword-matching group, so the whole predicate compiled to `title LIKE … OR excerpt LIKE … OR published = 1` — unpublished posts matching a keyword passed the first two disjuncts, and every published post passed the last one regardless of the keywords (the padding the reporter noticed). The fix hoists it to a top-level `.where('published', true)` that is AND-ed with the parenthesized OR group of keyword patterns, so results are exactly the published posts matching at least one keyword in title or excerpt; the untouched `index`/`show` actions keep their existing behaviour. I also added `tests/PostSearch.test.ts`, a feature test against the test SQLite database that seeds a published and two unpublished fixtures via `Post.forceCreate` (unpublished posts have no UI, and `published` is deliberately outside `Post.fillable`), covers the single-keyword, two-keyword, and unpublished-only-word cases, and deletes its fixtures in `afterAll`; the pre-existing 422 validation test in `tests/PostController.test.ts` is left as the sole owner of that case.
